'''Seldair Keeloo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who operated out of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:DIT" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Seldair Keeloo prior to the 2007 update]]
Seldair Keeloo was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CT">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Captain Thrawn|Naboo}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Seldair Keeloo was originally part of the initial version of the Imperial themepark in which Thrawn sent players to kill Keeloo near the [[Emperor's Retreat/Legends|Emperor's Retreat]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG:CT" /> However, in the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]], released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]],<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref> Keeloo was placed in Narmle on Rori and involved in a very different different quest.<ref name="SWG:DIT" />
